scope: Developer/IT technical expressions: typing and history
causes: Space correction on unknown technical terms: all seven changed at centered touches. Symbols end active lexical token; index.tsx final tsx becomes tax.
History trims punctuation without technical syntax awareness: dotfiles, relative paths, balanced parentheses and force-unwrap operator lose characters. Same cause as round124.
History admission maxDigits=12 excludes long IPv6 and IPv4:port; intentional sensitive-number heuristic has technical-address coverage cost.
Recall minLength=4 excludes C++, C#, F#; ::1 becomes 1 after trimming and then is excluded by admission length.
controls: tcp/ip, TCP/IP and sampled IPv4 typing preserved.
No assertion that all protocols or all IP addresses are safe.
limits: Synthetic inputs typed through production core packs; not live simulator.
Each case fresh profile and centered touches.
History tested independently via observe(text:); missing recall is not automatic text alteration.
Exporter XCTest passes mean evidence collection succeeded, not product correctness.
